resources.string: A private, locked place for entries you\'d rather keep to yourself.
Accounts and cards are found from your SMS. Tap one to name it or change its type. Debit cards are shown inside the account they take money from.
This edition never reads your messages by itself. Share SMS to the app, paste them, or import an SMS backup file.

1. Install “SMS Backup & Restore” from the Play Store.
2. In that app: Set up a backup → Messages only → choose a folder on this phone (not Google Drive) → Schedule: daily.
This edition can’t read your inbox by itself. A free SMS backup app can save your messages to a file every day, and this app reads the newest file each time you open it.

Creates a file you can open in Excel or Google Sheets. Hidden zone entries are never included.
The date is read from the SMS text. If the SMS has no date, today is used; you can change it later by tapping the entry.

To record your incoming and outgoing money automatically, AutoPocket Diary reads the SMS that banks and mobile wallets (bKash, Nagad, Rocket and others) send to this phone, including amounts, accounts and dates.

This happens only on your phone. The app has no internet access: your messages are never uploaded, shared or sent to the developer or anyone else. SMS that aren’t bank or wallet transactions are ignored and not stored.

You can turn this off at any time in your phone’s settings.
AutoPocket Diary reads your transaction SMS

Everything here works on this phone only. Nothing is uploaded, and there\'s no online or Google Drive backup. It\'s like saving a copy of your diary as a file, so you can keep it before resetting or changing your phone.
Fingerprint / screen lock: only to open the hidden zone, if you choose to. Android checks your fingerprint; the app never sees it.

Saves all your entries, titles and categories into one locked file. Copy that file somewhere safe (a computer, USB drive or memory card) before you reset or change your phone.

Set how much you want to spend each month per category. The home screen warns you at 80% and when you go over. Leave a box empty for no budget.
In your Messages app, touch and hold a bank or bKash SMS, tap Share, then choose AutoPocket Diary. You can select several SMS at once in some apps.
Shows this month\'s money in, out and net. To add it: touch and hold an empty spot on your home screen, choose Widgets, then AutoPocket Diary.

Android protects your SMS. For apps installed from outside the Play Store, it asks for one extra confirmation the first time. Follow these steps once:
SMS are read only on this phone. The app has no internet access and never sends your messages anywhere.

Do step 1 once more (so Android blocks it again), then go back to app info: the option usually appears after a blocked attempt. If your phone still doesn’t offer it, use AutoPocket Diary (standard edition) instead and add SMS by sharing them.
No ⋮ menu, or no “Allow restricted settings”?
SMS access is on. You’re all set.
Tap to see how to turn it on (takes a minute).
Tap the button. If Android shows a question, choose Allow, and you’re done. If it says the app was denied access or a setting is restricted, continue with step 2.
Tap “Open app info”. On that page, tap ⋮ (top-right corner), choose “Allow restricted settings”, and confirm with your phone PIN, pattern or fingerprint.
Still on app info, tap Permissions → SMS → Allow. Then come back here.

You choose where to save it. To keep it fully offline, choose a folder on your phone such as Downloads. If you pick an online location like Google Drive in the file picker, the file goes there instead.
Your data is stored encrypted on the phone.

Your personal diary of money coming in and going out.

It reads the transaction SMS from your bank, bKash, Nagad and other wallets, and adds them up for you: per account and in total.

You can also add cash expenses by hand, and give any entry your own title.
Your phone has no screen lock. If you forget this PIN, the hidden zone can only be erased and started again. Setting a phone screen lock is recommended.
Your phone has no screen lock, so there\'s no safe way to prove it\'s you. The only option is to erase the hidden zone: every hidden entry is deleted for good, then you can set a new PIN.
